subject: Insightix: post-demo evaluation pack, recommended models & perf links
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Russo <elena@insightix.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@insightix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Insightix — post-demo evaluation pack, recommended models & perf links

Hi Elena — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a practical next-step plan we discussed on the call, plus the model candidates we recommend for your customer support summarization / triage workload.

Key takeaways from our call:
- Volume profile: peak ~120 TPS across bursts, average sustained ~35 TPS per region (US east).
- Quality priority: precision on entity extraction + short-summary coherence (abstractive preferred).
- Latency target: p95 <= 220ms for 1–2 sentence summaries; cost sensitivity for long-term production.

Recommended model shortlist (Redwood-verified):
1) rdx-7b-clarity-q4_1: best balance of summary coherence and cost; 40 TPS baseline on one dedicated GPU, p50=85ms, p95=180–205ms (see perf pack).
2) open-13b-slim-quant: higher quality for edge cases (entities) with p95 ~240–300ms; recommend for canary traffic only.
3) rdx-3b-fast: low-latency fallback for strict SLOs, slightly lower entity recall but p95 ~120–150ms.

Artifacts I attached / linked:
- redwood_verified_profiles_insightix.csv (CSV export with throughput/latency percentiles and GPU footprints per model)
- insightix_prompt_set_v1.txt (seed prompts + guardrail examples we used for the benchmark)
- Drive perf pack (link) with traces, sample prompts, and prompt-regression checklist.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which model(s) you want included in a 2-week pilot (I suggest rdx-7b-clarity-q4_1 + rdx-3b-fast for fallback).
2) Share a short sample traffic slice (anonymized) or a set of 500 reprepro prompts so we can run a tailored regression check.
3) If procurement is involved, loop them now — I'll include an estimated pilot TCO and contract checklist.

If that sounds good, can we lock a pilot kickoff for the week of Jan 10? Karthik, can you add an initial capacity estimate for the two-model slate and a quick note on autoscaling behavior for burst to 120 TPS?

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

FW: notes for pilot sizing and perf expectations.

Marissa / Ben — quick notes from infra side:
- For the two-model slate (rdx-7b-clarity-q4_1 + rdx-3b-fast) to handle bursts to 120 TPS with p95 targets, we recommend a dedicated pool sized as follows:
  * rdx-7b: 2 x A100-40 (reserved) with continuous batching and prefix KV caching; expected sustained TPS ~60 per pool with p95 ~190–210ms under mixed prompt length.
  * rdx-3b (fallback): 1 x A100-40 for reserve fallback capacity; can serve ~100 TPS for short prompts with p95 ~140ms.
- Autoscale policy: aggressive scale-up (10s) for ephemeral bursts and gradual scale-down (5–10m) to avoid cost churn.
- Pilot TCO (rough): $7,200 for two-week reserved window (includes GPU hours, logging retention, basic SLO monitoring). We should add professional services hours (8h) for onboarding (~$2,400) if Insightix wants model tuning.

Ben — can you prepare the 1-page SOW and include the SOC2 evidence pointer (certificate + audit contact)? I'll include the autoscale config snippet.

Karthik
Director, Serving Infrastructure
